prompts.moonlit-atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production board-game component artwork atlas, not a UI or product photograph.
Create a high resolution landscape 3 by 2 perfectly regular atlas, six separate rectangular cells, equal dimensions, no gutters. Each cell must contain its COMPLETE component with generous safe margin, isolated on flat deep midnight navy background #12212c. No text, lettering, numbers, watermark, labels, or fake UI anywhere.
Art direction: Moonlit Storybook for Nuns on the Run, an affectionate mischievous abbey stealth game. Exquisitely hand-painted gouache, broad readable forms, chunky physical paper edges, luminous amber candles against rich Prussian blue and sage stone, richly illustrated crafted board game materials, soft moonlight. NOT vector art, NOT generic icons.
Top-left cell: complete portrait physical playing-card body centered, parchment lower 40 percent completely blank and quiet for runtime rules text, generous blank title plaque above; upper illustration shows a young nun sneaking with her shoes in her hands through an arched abbey corridor. Card aspect 2:3, gold ink worn edge.
Top-middle cell: same complete portrait card format and blank lower area, upper painting a blue glass medicine bottle and ornate brass abbey key resting on an oak pharmacy shelf.
Top-right cell: same complete portrait card format and blank lower area, upper painting candle flame surrounded by a gentle golden halo, a blessing.
Bottom-left cell: two complete die-cut full-body nun standees SIDE BY SIDE with ample separation, one young novice in teal habit with curious face tiptoeing; one imposing older abbess black habit carrying lantern and staff. Broad recognizable silhouettes, physical ivory die-cut rim, base. No scenery behind them. All parts fit within this cell.
Bottom-middle cell: four complete round physical cardboard tokens in 2 by 2 arrangement, ivory die-cut rims. Top-left bold brass bell/noise symbol, top-right a white disappearing silhouette with a trailing cape/vanished symbol, bottom-left a single ornate brass key, bottom-right single blue glass medicine bottle. Large recognizable silhouettes, subordinate texture, no tiny marks.
Bottom-right cell: complete portrait reverse of playing card, dark navy parchment with ornate golden abbey arch, large moon at center, subtle floral corner flourishes, no text. Next to it one small complete ivory six-sided die showing FIVE pips front-on. All pieces fully inside cell.
Intended assembly: each cell will be cropped into reusable graphical game layers; live title, numbers, state and descriptions supplied in HTML later. Cards shown 220 by 330 CSS pixels minimum, standees at least 100px tall, tokens at least 64px diameter. Essential subjects must have clear broad forms at those sizes. Keep each object separate and do not let any art cross a cell boundary. Flat orthographic/front-on views, no tabletop camera perspective.
prompts.moonlit-board:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone illustrated board for a digital board game, landscape 3:2 composition. Original artwork for Nuns on the Run, Moonlit Storybook direction.
A magnificent, readable, orthographic TOP DOWN cutaway plan of a medieval abbey at night, exquisitely hand-painted in gouache with warm amber windows and cool Prussian blue stone. Complete physical rectangular game board with restrained worn gold and midnight blue cardboard rim, filling canvas nearly edge to edge. Large central cloister courtyard with herb garden and circular fountain, broad connected quiet stone corridors circling it, six small novice bedrooms along left wing, tall chapel upper right with pews and altar, pharmacy right side with cabinets, kitchen lower right with ovens, library lower left with shelves, abbess cell upper left. Exterior herb gardens and a few cypress trees. Roofs removed so floor plan is clear. Rooms and passageways easily distinguished by large shapes and warm/cool regions. Magical, cozy and conspiratorial mood; charming board game illustration, rich painterly materials, restrained detail, no horror.
Reserve broad low texture floor areas for live nodes and pieces: keep central corridors quiet and clearly connected. NO baked-in route dots, NO letters, NO text, NO numbers, NO tokens, NO characters, NO cards, NO UI. Decoration stays inside rooms and away from wide corridor floor space. Perspective strictly top-down, no tilted camera. Not a screenshot, not vector, not diagram, not an aerial exterior painting.
Intended rendered board minimum 900px wide in scrollable/zoomable map area; live 16-20px node labels overlaid later, not painted. This is an art-direction study, not a claim of exact published topology.
prompts.moonlit-board-canonical:
Use case: style-transfer.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET and exact geometric reference: the original Nuns on the Run abbey floor plan. Input 2 is ONLY the approved Moonlit Storybook paint/material style reference; DO NOT adopt its incorrect room layout.
Create a production painted BOARD UNDERLAY by repainting Input 1 in the gouache style of Input 2. The result MUST retain Input 1's exact composition, aspect ratio, pixel-aligned footprint, all room positions, all room shapes, wall endpoints, alcoves, doorways, corridors, central cloister and garden boundaries. No resizing, no rearrangement, no invented rooms or doorways. Every structural feature should superimpose on Input 1. This is a precision restyling, NOT a redesign.
STYLE: warm amber candlelight on cool blue-gray stone floors and sage moonlit gardens, richly hand-painted gouache and restrained physical cardboard texture, cozy mischievous abbey, broad brushwork. Keep passage floors quiet so live route overlays remain visible.
Critical architecture: irregular chapel upper-left, its altar blocking niche near x38% y20%, its TWO closed confessionals near x24% and x52% y37%; outer and inner gardens left; tree at x17% y56%; central cloister at x46–82% y39–73% including the small curved solid enclosure at x71–77% y52–60%; library and scriptorium above cloister; pantry kitchen and refectory on top right; pharmacy middle right; entry hall far right; novice cells along bottom; Abbess cell lower middle-right; Prioress cell beside it; laundry and main store lower left. These coordinates refer to Input1. Preserve all exact partitions. Do not add partitions at columns, trees, furniture or statues. Do not enlarge furniture into route areas.
No text, numbers, route lines, keys, locks, tokens, characters, UI or extra border: all precise gameplay marks are separate overlays. Do not introduce visual obstacles that aren't in Input 1. All four edges and the entire original footprint retained. Match target Input1 upright almost-square 2504:2599 aspect, not the landscape aspect of style reference Input2.

usage.moonlit-board: Retained only as the style input for the corrected board; not used at runtime.
usage.moonlit-board-canonical: Runtime painting; original topology is supplied by the factual board manifest.
